class.name: SourcePPBSP
class.brief_description: Loads Source BSP brush geometry into [HalfEdgeMesh] data.
class.description: [SourcePPBSP] exposes a first-cut wrapper over SourcePP's BSP reader for Source engine maps. It currently focuses on brush-model surface extraction for later import work: it can open a BSP, list the discovered materials, keep one editable [HalfEdgeMesh] and aligned face-material map as object state, and generate a renderable node from that current state. Displacement surfaces are skipped for now. Returned vertices are converted from Source inches and axes into Godot meters and orientation.

method.name: close
method.description: Releases the currently loaded BSP and all cached parsed data.

method.name: create_node
method.description: Creates a 3D node hierarchy from the selected BSP brush model. When [member model_index] is [code]0[/code], the returned root node stores BSP metadata, contains a [MeshInstance3D] child named [code]WorldGeometry[/code] for worldspawn, and contains a [code]BModels[/code] child with placed brush-model entity nodes for entity [code]model="*N"[/code] references. Brush entity nodes store [code]sourcepp_bsp_entity_keyvalues[/code] plus model/entity index metadata, and their [code]Geometry[/code] child stores the generated mesh. When [member model_index] is nonzero, only that brush model is emitted for inspection. World geometry is emitted as separate opaque and transparent Godot mesh surfaces using generated shader materials. Each shader samples a [Texture2DArray], while each vertex stores the BSP material layer in a custom mesh attribute. Opaque materials use alpha scissor for cutout texture pixels; blended materials are kept in the transparent surface. When a [member resolver] is assigned, referenced VMT and VTF files are loaded while creating the node. The BSP's embedded Pakfile lump is mounted into the resolver while the BSP is open, allowing map-packed materials and textures to resolve before external game content. Missing materials use a generated checker texture layer. The returned root node, [code]WorldGeometry[/code] child, and generated shader materials store [code]sourcepp_bsp_asset_metadata[/code], a dictionary keyed by resolved or requested asset path. Each value includes [code]asset_source[/code] ([code]"PAK"[/code], [code]"non-PAK"[/code], or [code]"unknown"[/code]), [code]is_missing[/code], [code]asset_type[/code], [code]material_type[/code], and a nested [code]metadata[/code] dictionary.

method.name: get_face_material_ids
method.description: Returns one material ID per face in the current [member halfedge_mesh]. Each ID indexes [method get_material_paths]. Faces without a resolved material return [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_material_paths
method.description: Returns the unique BSP material paths referenced by the currently loaded map. [member face_material_ids] indexes this array.

method.name: get_model_count
method.description: Returns the number of brush models stored in the BSP.

method.name: open
method.description: Opens a BSP file from disk and caches the brush-model geometry, texture info, and material table needed for mesh extraction. The currently selected [member model_index] is immediately converted into [member halfedge_mesh] and [member face_material_ids].

method.name: open_from_buffer
method.description: Opens a BSP from raw bytes. If [param path] is provided, it becomes the logical source path used for metadata and resolver-relative lookups while the parser itself uses an internal temporary backing file.

method.name: set_model_index
method.description: Selects which BSP brush model is mirrored into [member halfedge_mesh] and [member face_material_ids]. If a BSP is already open, changing this rebuilds the current editable mesh state. [method create_node] imports the full map scene with entity-placed bmodels when this is [code]0[/code], and imports only the selected brush model when nonzero.

members.member: One material ID per face in [member halfedge_mesh]. These IDs index [method get_material_paths].
The current editable BSP brush-model mesh.
The BSP brush model currently mirrored into [member halfedge_mesh].
Optional Source asset resolver used by [method create_node] to load VMTs, textures, and other referenced files.
Optional game identifier used with [member resolver] when resolving Source assets.
